notice: Modified by Evnola OU on 2026-11-08: the line 'git submodule update --init' in autogen.sh of FreeType is replaced by an error message and 'exit 1'.
reason: autogen.sh runs 'git submodule update --init' when subprojects/dlg/include/dlg is missing, which would download dlg from the network. The locked dlg is placed there by build.py before the build, so this branch is dead code; if the layout ever breaks, the build stops instead of fetching anything.
